label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The issue describes uploads failing with "Malformed row" on row 1 due to the new accounting export tool on Windows. Windows exports typically use CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings, which causes issues when parsing or splitting lines if carriage returns are not properly stripped or handled in `src/ingest/parser.ts`.
